subject.title: fix(session): defer flushPendingToolResults by one event-loop tick

question: Should maintainers require redacted Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before accepting this one-tick flush timing change?
rationale: The source boundary and focused tests line up with the reported race, but the PR is external and the reported failure is user-visible channel/session behavior that has not been proven on the PR head.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output, production-runner logs, or comparable live proof showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

options.title: Accept source-only timing risk
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally merge based on source and focused tests, while owning that the reported Feishu path was not proven here.

options.title: Pause behind canonical issue
options.body: Keep this PR paused behind https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/84134 if no one can produce real transport or production-runner proof.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu DM output, production-runner logs, or comparable live proof showing the real tool result is persisted without a synthetic missing-result entry before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The session guard and synthetic pending-result behavior sit in the code boundary introduced by this owner history.
